description: Edit a questionnaire: title, description, thanks message, task, questions (list or markdown), status open/closed, or regenerate=true for a new link (the old one stops working).

issue.description: issue the answers are added to as a comment, e.g. "WEB-12"

markdown.description: the questions as Markdown: headings are sections, list items are questions

questions.description: the questions as a list (instead of markdown)

id.description: keep the id of an existing question when editing so answers stay attached

type.description: section = heading; choice = pick one of `options`; multi = pick several

regenerate.description: true = a new public link; the old one stops working

status.description: open = takes answers, closed = no longer takes answers

thanks.description: message shown after the client sends the answers

name: update_form
